rule_changes.meaning: signal at the close of t, fill at the close of t+1, close-snapshot spread costs
rule_changes.basis: D4 cost measurement only (open half spread ~4.1x the 15:45 one); announced in docs/research-program.zh.md at 07:50 UTC before any Stage 2 number and before T-11
rule_changes.verdict_uses: close only (a swap, not a second chance)

opt_config.source: optimize.OptConfig defaults at the bound commit
opt_config.failure: every step of the retry ladder failed or max constraint violation > 1e-4; gate on this final failure rate (median over offsets < 2%)

ic_scaling.formation_dates: last session of each calendar month (session calendar)
ic_scaling.formula: IC_t = max(0, 0.5 * mean_rank_ic + 0.5 * 0.03); IC_t = 0.03 when fewer than 12 formation dates
ic_scaling.apply: decider.spec = BookSpec(name, opt.with_(ic=IC_t)) before each decide call

m1.weights: proportional to max(0, mean_ic / sd_ic); fall back to M0 equal weights if < 24 obs or all zero
m1.update: first rebalance after each month end

target_y: returns.forward_open_to_open over t+1..t+22 opens minus sum_{k=t+1}^{t+21} X_t' f_k (risk/factor_returns_<year>.parquet, X_t at the month-end storage date)

composite.theme_score: mean of the processed z columns of the theme, missing = 0
composite.score: M0: equal-weight mean of 9 theme scores; M1: IC-IR weights; then optimize.rank_normal inside the decider's universe

items.cost2x: spread, impact, fees x2; borrow 100 bp/yr on all shorts

sensitivity_runs.timing_flag: close gross Sharpe < 0.5 x open gross Sharpe (anchor or stress) -> 'timing sensitive', lead review before any forward shadow

tiers.watch_recent: no research_pass AND anchor: median net Sharpe >= 1.19, 2x-cost annual excess > 0, daily beta and Dimson beta within +-0.15, median failure rate < 2%, placebo beat >= 0.80 on both net and gross Sharpe
tiers.forward_rules: runbook section 5 (3 months forward Sharpe < 0.5 or forward max drawdown > 1.5x anchor drawdown -> remove); program stop rule (63 sessions, Sharpe < 0 and below the placebo median -> review)

placebo.scope: variants passing condition (1) and variants with anchor median net Sharpe >= 1.19
placebo.seeds: s = 0..99, rng seed 20261001 + s, offset = s mod 5
placebo.permutation: within each rebalance date, inside the variant's universe, before alpha scaling; IC_t series, risk, cost, constraints, short sets as in the real run
placebo.beat: real Sharpe on the same offset > seed Sharpe, computed separately on net and gross Sharpe; both must meet: full sample >= 0.95, stress >= 0.80, anchor >= 0.80 (watch_recent: anchor only)

reporting_only: T-11 phases (data/research/equity_book/regimes/phases.json phases_recent and phases_hist) on the offset-blend
forward segment from 2026-09-18 after the data refresh
DSR with 77 trials (open-exec runs are sensitivity, not trials)
leave-one-theme-out diagnostic (prereg section 7): M0_A offset 0, 9 paths, other 8 themes equal weight, IC_t = M0_A's real series, no replays, not trials

binding_rule.precondition: queue status of T-20261001-05 and T-20261001-06 starts with 'done'
binding_rule.method: git status --porcelain must be empty for every code file; record git log -1 --format=%H and sha256sum per file; record sha256 of data files; any later change voids T-08/T-13/T-14 results
